        self.slow.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

            self.previous_slow = self.slow.Current.Value
            return

        current_slow = self.slow.Current.Value

                    .Exchange.Hours
                    .GetPreviousTradingDay(self.held_expiry)

            self.Debug("Skipped entry: expiration safeguard already triggered today")

            self.Debug("Skipped entry: option position or entry order already exists")
            return

            self.Debug("Skipped entry: invalid SPY price")
            return

        self.held_expiry = selected.Expiry.date()
        self.entry_price = None
        self.entry_symbol = selected.Symbol

        ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected.Symbol, 1)

        if not self.Portfolio[selected.Symbol].Invested:
            self.entry_order_id = ticket.OrderId

        self.Debug(
            f"Entry submitted: {selected.Symbol}, expiry {selected_expiry}, "
            f"strike {selected.Strike}"
        )

        if self.entry_price is None or self.exit_order_id is not None:

        bid = 0
        ask = 0

                    ask = contract.AskPrice

            )
            self.SubmitExit("50% profit target")

        if quantity == 0:

        for order in self.Transactions.GetOpenOrders(self.held_symbol):

            self.exit_order_id = ticket.OrderId

        self.Debug(f"Exit submitted ({reason}): {self.held_symbol}")

                self.held_expiry = None
                self.entry_price = None
                self.entry_order_id = None
                self.exit_order_id = None
                self.entry_symbol = None
            return

        if (
            self.entry_symbol is not None and
            order_event.Symbol == self.entry_symbol and
            order_event.Direction == OrderDirection.Buy and
            order_event.Status == OrderStatus.Filled
        ):
            self.entry_price = order_event.FillPrice
            self.entry_order_id = None
            self.entry_symbol = None
            self.Debug(
                f"Entry filled: {order_event.Symbol}, "
                f"price {self.entry_price:.2f}"
            )
            return

        if (

            order_event.Direction == OrderDirection.Sell and

from datetime import timedelta, time


class SpyFiveMinuteCallCrossover(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetTimeZone(TimeZones.NewYork)
        self.SetStartDate(2023, 4, 1)
        self.SetEndDate(2026, 6, 30)
        self.SetCash(100000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Minute).Symbol
        self.Securities[self.spy].SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Raw)

        option = self.AddOption("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        self.option_symbol = option.Symbol
        option.SetFilter(
            lambda universe: universe.IncludeWeeklys()
            .Strikes(-100, 100)
            .Expiration(0, 180)
        )

        self.fast = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self.slow = SimpleMovingAverage(20)

        self._crossover_pending = False
        self._pending_bar_end = None

        self._entry_order_id = None
        self._entry_symbol = None
        self._entry_price = None

        self._held_symbol = None
        self._expiration = None
        self._time_stop_date = None
        self._exit_order_id = None
        self._block_entries_date = None

        consolidator = TradeBarConsolidator(timedelta(minutes=5))
        consolidator.DataConsolidated += self._on_five_minute_bar
        self.SubscriptionManager.AddConsolidator(self.spy, consolidator)

    def _on_five_minute_bar(self, sender, bar):
        previous_ready = self.fast.IsReady and self.slow.IsReady
        previous_fast = self.fast.Current.Value if previous_ready else None
        previous_slow = self.slow.Current.Value if previous_ready else None

        self.fast.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        self._crossover_pending = (
            previous_ready
            and self.fast.IsReady
            and self.slow.IsReady
            and previous_fast <= previous_slow
            and self.fast.Current.Value > self.slow.Current.Value
        )
        self._pending_bar_end = bar.EndTime if self._crossover_pending else None

    def OnData(self, data):
        self._process_expiration_safety()
        self._process_time_stop()
        self._process_profit_target(data)

        if self._crossover_pending:
            bar_end = self._pending_bar_end
            self._crossover_pending = False
            self._pending_bar_end = None

            if self._eligible_entry_time(bar_end):
                self._try_enter(data)

    def _eligible_entry_time(self, bar_end):
        if bar_end is None:
            return False

        bar_time = bar_end.time()
        return time(9, 45) <= bar_time <= time(14, 30)

    def _try_enter(self, data):
        if self._block_entries_date == self.Time.date():
            return

        if self._held_symbol is not None or self._entry_order_id is not None:
            return

        if self.option_symbol not in data.OptionChains:
            self.Debug("Entry skipped: no SPY option chain.")
            return

        chain = data.OptionChains[self.option_symbol]
        current_date = self.Time.date()
        minimum_expiry = current_date + timedelta(days=7)

        eligible = [
            contract
            for contract in chain
            if contract.Right == OptionRight.Call
            and contract.Expiry.date() >= minimum_expiry
        ]

        if not eligible:
            self.Debug("Entry skipped: no call expiration at least 7 calendar days away.")
            return

        expiry_date = min(contract.Expiry.date() for contract in eligible)
        spy_price = self.Securities[self.spy].Price
        minimum_strike = spy_price * 1.01

        candidates = [
            contract
            for contract in eligible
            if contract.Expiry.date() == expiry_date
            and contract.Strike >= minimum_strike
        ]

        if not candidates:
            self.Debug("Entry skipped: no qualifying OTM call at selected expiration.")
            return

        selected = min(candidates, key=lambda c: (c.Strike, str(c.Symbol)))
        ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected.Symbol, 1)

        self._entry_order_id = ticket.OrderId
        self._entry_symbol = selected.Symbol
        self.Debug(
            f"Entry submitted: {selected.Symbol} strike {selected.Strike} expiry {selected.Expiry.date()}."
        )

    def _process_profit_target(self, data):
        if self._held_symbol is None or self._entry_price is None:
            return

        if self._exit_order_id is not None:
            return

        if self._held_symbol not in data.QuoteBars:
            return

        quote = data.QuoteBars[self._held_symbol]
        if quote.Bid is None or quote.Ask is None:
            return

        bid = quote.Bid.Close
        ask = quote.Ask.Close
        if bid <= 0 or ask <= 0:
            return

        midpoint = (bid + ask) / 2.0
        if midpoint >= self._entry_price * 1.50:
            self._submit_exit("profit target")

    def _process_time_stop(self):
        if (
            self._held_symbol is not None
            and self._time_stop_date is not None
            and self.Time.date() == self._time_stop_date
            and self.Time.time() == time(15, 45)
            and self._exit_order_id is None
        ):
            self._submit_exit("15:45 pre-expiration time stop")

    def _process_expiration_safety(self):
        if self._held_symbol is None or self._expiration is None:
            return

        if self.Time.date() >= self._expiration.date():
            self._block_entries_date = self.Time.date()
            if self._exit_order_id is None:
                self._submit_exit("expiration safety")

    def _submit_exit(self, reason):
        if self._held_symbol is None:
            return

        quantity = self.Portfolio[self._held_symbol].Quantity
        if quantity == 0:
            return

        for order in self.Transactions.GetOpenOrders(self._held_symbol):
            if order.Id != self._entry_order_id:
                self.Transactions.CancelOrder(order.Id)

        ticket = self.MarketOrder(self._held_symbol, -quantity)
        self._exit_order_id = ticket.OrderId
        self.Debug(f"Exit submitted ({reason}): {self._held_symbol}.")

    def OnOrderEvent(self, order_event):
        if getattr(order_event, "IsAssignment", False) or order_event.OrderType == OrderType.OptionExercise:
            self.Debug(f"Unexpected option exercise or assignment: {order_event.Symbol}.")
            self._block_entries_date = self.Time.date()

        if order_event.OrderId == self._entry_order_id:
            if order_event.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
                self._held_symbol = self._entry_symbol
                self._entry_price = order_event.FillPrice
                self._expiration = self._held_symbol.ID.Date
                self._time_stop_date = self.Securities[self.spy].Exchange.Hours.GetPreviousTradingDay(
                    self._expiration
                ).date()
                self.Debug(
                    f"Entry filled: {self._held_symbol} at {self._entry_price}."
                )
                self._entry_order_id = None
                self._entry_symbol = None
            elif order_event.Status in (OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid):
                self.Debug(f"Entry order closed without fill: {order_event.Symbol}.")
                self._entry_order_id = None
                self._entry_symbol = None

        if order_event.OrderId == self._exit_order_id:
            if order_event.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
                self.Debug(f"Exit filled: {order_event.Symbol} at {order_event.FillPrice}.")
                self._held_symbol = None
                self._entry_price = None
                self._expiration = None
                self._time_stop_date = None
                self._exit_order_id = None
            elif order_event.Status in (OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid):
                self.Debug(f"Exit order closed without fill: {order_event.Symbol}.")
                self._exit_order_id = None

        end_time = bar.EndTime
        minute_of_day = end_time.hour * 60 + end_time.minute

        # Regular-session minute bars end from 09:31 through 16:00.
        if minute_of_day < 9 * 60 + 31 or minute_of_day > 16 * 60:
            return

        bucket_end = ((minute_of_day + 4) // 5) * 5

        self.bucket_close = bar.Close

        if minute_of_day != bucket_end:
            return

        expected_minutes = set(range(bucket_end - 4, bucket_end + 1))
        if self.bucket_minutes != expected_minutes:
            return

        self._on_completed_five_minute_bar(self.bucket_close, data)

    def _on_completed_five_minute_bar(self, close, data):

        slow = sum(values) / 20.0

            self.previous_fast is not None
            and self.previous_slow is not None
            and self.previous_fast <= self.previous_slow

        )

        self.previous_slow = slow

            self._submit_exit("expiration processing")

            return

        end_time = bar.EndTime

        if local_time < time(9, 31) or local_time > time(16, 0):

        if ticket is not None:
            self.entry_order_id = ticket.OrderId
            self.Debug(
                f"Entry submitted: {selected.Symbol}, strike {selected.Strike}, "
                f"expiry {selected.Expiry.date()}."
            )

    def CheckProfitTarget(self, data):
        if (
            self.held_contract is None
            or self.entry_price is None
            or self.exit_order_id is not None
            or not self.Portfolio[self.held_contract].Invested
        ):
            return

        if self.held_contract not in data.QuoteBars:
            return

        quote = data.QuoteBars[self.held_contract]
        if quote.Bid is None or quote.Ask is None:
            return

        bid = quote.Bid.Close
        ask = quote.Ask.Close

        if bid <= 0 or ask <= 0:
            return

        midpoint = (bid + ask) / 2.0
        if midpoint >= self.entry_price * 1.50:
            self.Debug(
                f"Profit target exit: {self.held_contract}, midpoint {midpoint:.2f}, "
                f"entry {self.entry_price:.2f}."
            )
            self.SubmitExitOrder("profit target")

    def CheckTimeStop(self):
        if (
            self.held_contract is None
            or self.exit_order_id is not None
            or not self.Portfolio[self.held_contract].Invested
        ):
            return

        expiry = self.held_contract.ID.Date
        next_trading_day = self.Securities[self.spy].Exchange.Hours.GetNextTradingDay(self.Time)

        if next_trading_day.date() == expiry.date():
            self.Debug(f"15:45 pre-expiration exit: {self.held_contract}")
            self.SubmitExitOrder("pre-expiration time stop")

    def SubmitExitOrder(self, reason):
        if self.held_contract is None or self.exit_order_id is not None:
            return

        for order in self.Transactions.GetOpenOrders(self.held_contract):
            self.Transactions.CancelOrder(order.Id, f"Cancelled before {reason}")

        quantity = self.Portfolio[self.held_contract].Quantity
        if quantity != 0:
            ticket = self.MarketOrder(self.held_contract, -quantity)
            if ticket is not None:
                self.exit_order_id = ticket.OrderId

    def OnOrderEvent(self, order_event):
        if order_event.OrderType == OrderType.OptionExercise:
            self.Debug(
                f"Unexpected option exercise or assignment handling: "
                f"{order_event.Symbol}, status {order_event.Status}."
            )

        if order_event.OrderId == self.entry_order_id:
            if order_event.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
                self.held_contract = order_event.Symbol
                self.entry_price = order_event.FillPrice
                self.entry_order_id = None
                self.Debug(
                    f"Entry filled: {self.held_contract} at {self.entry_price:.2f}."
                )
            elif order_event.Status in (OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid):
                self.entry_order_id = None
                self.Debug(f"Entry order closed without fill: {order_event.Symbol}.")

        if order_event.OrderId == self.exit_order_id:
            if order_event.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
                self.Debug(f"Exit filled: {order_event.Symbol} at {order_event.FillPrice:.2f}.")
                self.held_contract = None
                self.entry_price = None
                self.exit_order_id = None
            elif order_event.Status in (OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid):
                self.exit_order_id = None
